definition: any of many slender, soft-bodied animals, some segmented, that live by burrowing underground, in water or as parasites, including the annelids, nemerteans, nematodes, platyhelminths, acanthocephalans, and gordian worms; a worm.
example_en: During the rainy season worms are seen more often in the soil.

definition: the perennial vine Citrullus colocynthus (= Cucumis colocynthis) of Cucurbitaceae family; colocynth.
example_en: The fruit of the colocynth vine is used for medicine.

definition: any woman who engages in promiscuous sexual intercourse; a whore.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮಿಂಡಗಾತಿ ಇದ್ದಳೆಂದು ಜನ ಮಾತನಾಡಿಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: People talked that there was a promiscuous woman in that town.

definition: a conducting or managing of a business or directing the affairs of a company, firm, etc.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ವಹಿವಾಟ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The shop's business went well this year.

definition: the state or quality of being independent; independence.
example_en: Everyone admired her independence.

definition: a large number of people gathered closely together; a crowd.
example_en: A crowd of people had gathered at the market.

definition: the caste of fishermen.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊಗೇರ ಜನಾಂಗದವರು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಇದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: The fishermen caste people are mostly present in that town.

definition: one who makes or sells gloves; a glover.
example_en: The glover sells various kinds of gloves in his shop.

definition: a male human being; a man.
example: ಆ ಗಂಡಾಳು ಊರಿನ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That man was foremost in all the work of the village.

definition: a kind of pigeon, whose entrance into the house, is considered inauspicious.
example_en: The elders considered the entry of that pigeon an ill omen.

definition: the tender grass.
example_en: The cows were grazing on the tender grass in the field.

definition: to walk; to move on one's feet.
example_en: In the early morning they were walking in the garden.

definition: rays of heat; hot rays (as of the sun).
example_en: The hot rays dried up the crops.

definition: the state or quality of being weak; weakness.
example_en: His weakness increased due to illness.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.
example_en: The crow-pheasant calls in the morning.

definition: the military forces of a nation, exclusive of the navy and the air force; army.
example_en: The army advanced toward the border.

definition: a small, wrapped bundle; a package; a parcel.
example_en: That parcel has not arrived yet.

definition: lacking; without.
example: ಅವನು ಯಾವ ಕಾರಣವೂ ಬಗರ್ ಮನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಹೋದನು.
example_en: He left home without any reason at all.

definition: the uncomfortable or distressful feeling caused by a desire or need for water and characterised generally by a sensation of dryness in the mouth and throat; thirst.
example_en: Walking the whole way, she felt thirsty.

definition: any of several vegetable substances, as cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg or pepper, that have distinctive flavours and aromas, used to season food.
example_en: Mother made sambar in the morning.

definition: to make less; to decrease; to lessen.
example_en: After taking the medicine, the pain lessened.

definition: the condition of not existing; non-existence.
example_en: The non-existence of that object was proved.

definition: a heap of chaff.
example_en: A heap of chaff had grown tall near the threshing floor.

definition: the state of having lost one's power; diminished strength.
example: ರೋಗದ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ಕಡುಬಲ್ಮೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: After the illness his diminished strength was clearly visible.

definition: a south Indian sect of strong followers of Śiva with tantric connotations, and who carry a skull as a bowl for food.
example_en: The Kapalika was engaged in the worship of Shiva.

definition: a ghost, spirit, which moves in the air.
example: ಆ ಗಾಳಿಗ ಗಿಡದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸುತ್ತಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say that ghost hovers over the tree.

definition: (a bee) to drink the nectar of flowers.
example: ಆ ಜೇನುಹುಳ ಹೂವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಬಂಡುಣಿತು.
example_en: The bee sat on the flower and drank its nectar.

definition: an exact reproduction of another.
example_en: That picture was like an exact reproduction of the original.

definition: parching sunlight.
example_en: In summer the fields dried up due to the parching sunlight.

definition: a woman who shampoos another person or other persons; masseuse.
example: ಅಂಗಮರ್ದಕಿ ಅವನ ಬೆನ್ನನ್ನು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಸಾಜ್ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The masseuse slowly massaged his back.

definition: to give pleasure, satisfaction; to delight.
example_en: That word gave me pleasure.

definition: not affected; free from inhibitions.
example_en: That boy is of an uninhibited nature.

definition: to stir (a liquid or pasty item) as to make the sediments suspend throughout; to agitate slightly.
example_en: He stirred the gruel slightly with a ladle.

definition: the tendency of a person who is maliciously annoying.
example_en: No one could tolerate his maliciously annoying nature.

definition: heated sand.
example_en: In summer, the heated sand was burning to the feet.

definition: a series of waves, one following the other in frequent succession.
example_en: The series of successive waves of the ocean crashed on the shore.

definition: a person who has specialised in the study of astronomy.
example_en: That astronomer discovered a new planet.

definition: soldiers trained, armed, and equipped to fight on foot; infantry.
example: ರಾಜ್ಯದ ನರಬಲ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಕ್ರಮಣ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The kingdom's infantry attacked the enemies.

definition: to be hasty, impetuous; to hurry unreasonably.
example_en: One should not be hasty during an exam.

definition: to represent by a symbol or symbols; to symbolise.
example_en: They symbolised peace with a white dove.

definition: a kind of war weapon.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಸೈನಿಕರ ಬಳಿ ಮೊಗ್ಗರಣೆ ಎಂಬ ಆಯುಧವಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Ancient soldiers had a weapon called moggaraṇe.

definition: a garland of white or colourless glass beads and corals.
example_en: At the wedding she wore a garland of white glass beads and corals.

definition: health, considered as wealth.
example_en: He who has the wealth of health is the truly rich man.

definition: a defence weapon.
example_en: The soldier stood holding the defence weapon.

definition: thickly populated with; dense.
example_en: That area was densely populated.

definition: faith one has in a religious holy scripture.
example: ಆ ಭಕ್ತನಿಗೆ ವೇದಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಪೋಥೀಭಕ್ತಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That devotee had deep faith in the sacred scriptures.

definition: an oil that reduces friction by providing a smooth film as a covering over parts that move against each other; a lubricant oil.
example_en: They applied lubricant oil to the machine's gears.

definition: the bird Cuculus melanoleucus, fabled to live only upon rain drops.
example_en: The dharata bird was waiting only for the rain to come.

definition: an acute, highly contagious, febrile disease, caused by the variola virus, and characterised by vomiting, prolonged fever, a pustular eruption that often leaves permanent pits or scars; small-pox.
example: ಆ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಮೈಲಿ ಬಂದು ಮೈಯೆಲ್ಲಾ ಗುಳ್ಳೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The child got small-pox and its whole body erupted in pustules.

definition: the black colour.
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಕರಿದು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The black colour of that cloth is very dear to her.

definition: to send a message written in a letter; to send a letter.
example_en: He wished to send a letter to his friend.

definition: to falter or miss a step (while walking).
example_en: While walking among the stones, he faltered and missed a step.

definition: to sweep with or as with a broom.
example_en: She sweeps the house every morning.

definition: a kind of fish .
example_en: A kind of fish was swimming in the small pond.

definition: a body of people having religion, caste, etc., in common; a community.
example_en: That community celebrates a festival once a year.

definition: anything that hinders or obstructs; an obstruction; hindrance.
example_en: The construction work faced an obstruction from the government.

definition: the flesh of a dead person.
example_en: The vultures swarmed to eat the flesh of the corpse.

definition: a property, an object deposited with a person or persons or a body of persons for the purpose of keeping, maintaining, till certain conditions are met, such as the beneficiary attains certain age.
example: ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೊಂದು ವರ್ಷ ತುಂಬಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅನ್ವಾಹಿತವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After the son turned twenty-one, the deposited property was handed over to him.

definition: a stocky, long-haired wild ox (Bos grunniens); yak.
example_en: A ceremonial fan is made from the tail hair of the yak.

definition: any of various wolf-like carnivores (family Hyaenidae) of Africa and Asia, with powerful jaws, a bristly mane, short hind legs, and a characteristic shrill cry; hyena.
example_en: The shrill cry of the hyena was heard in the forest.

definition: a three-legged stool of low height; a tripod.
example: ಅವನು ತಿವಿಗೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಲು ಚಾಚಿ ಕುಳಿತನು.
example_en: He sat on the low three-legged stool with his legs stretched out.

definition: with a slapping sound.
example_en: The door closed with a slapping sound.

definition: an object of worldly enjoyment, pleasure.
example_en: The saint had no interest in worldly pleasures.

definition: a fresh, delicious fruit.
example_en: The fresh fruit brought from the garden was delicious.

definition: to have trust, confidence or rely on; to have faith.
example_en: He has great trust in his teacher.

definition: quickness; swiftness.
example: ಆತನ ಕೆಲಸದ ಛಳೆಯ ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was amazed at the swiftness of his work.

definition: a dismissing of a legal case in a court of law; dismissal.
example_en: The judge dismissed that legal case.

definition: the physical structure, including the bones, flesh, and organs, of a person; the body.
example_en: That old man's body was weak.

definition: the act of covering, enveloping (completely).
example_en: The priest completely covered the idol with flowers.

definition: a man who is composed and cool in nature.
example_en: He remained a calm, composed man even in difficulty.

definition: the advanced stage in a person's life; old age.
example_en: In old age his health gradually declined.

definition: a man who fights (in a war); a warrior; a soldier.
example_en: That soldier fought bravely on the battlefield.

definition: the highest bidder in an auction.
example_en: The highest bidder won the auction.

definition: a hillock; a mound.
example_en: A mound was visible outside the village.

definition: a person owing something to another or others; a debtor.
example: ಆ ರುಣಿ ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸಲು ಭೂಮಿ ಮಾರಿದನು.
example_en: That debtor sold his land to repay the loan.

definition: money paid or to be paid for transportation in a train, taxi, plane, etc.; fare.
example_en: The taxi fare was very expensive.

definition: any ornament worn to enhance the beauty.
example_en: The bride was wearing a golden ornament around her neck.

definition: a lively and cheerful man.
example_en: He is a lively, cheerful man who makes everyone laugh.

definition: again; once more.
example_en: She came to that town once again.

definition: a woman having squint eyes.
example_en: The woman with squint eyes narrowed her eyes and looked.

definition: a theory, philosophical principle, etc. that has been talked about by many for years and hence has become weary to listen.
example_en: His speech was merely a stale, worn-out theory.

definition: a yellow to dark brown, addicting, narcotic drug prepared from the juice of the unripe seed capsules of the opium poppy, which contains such alkaloids as morphine, codeine, and papaverine, and is used as an intoxicant and medicinally to relieve pain and produce sleep.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ನೋವು ಶಮನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಅಪೀಮು ನೀಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor gave a little opium to relieve the pain.

definition: a superficial wound; a scratch.
example_en: He got a scratch in the thorny bush.

definition: an ornament for the wrist.
example_en: She had put on a beautiful wrist-ornament on her hand.

definition: a guarding by a man in person.
example_en: The fort was safe due to the king's personal guarding.

definition: a puppet or little jointed figure made to look like a person or animal and moved by strings or wires from above, often on a miniature stage; a marionette.
example: ಜಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಕಿಳ್ಳೇಕೇತದ ಆಟ ನೋಡಿ ಸಂತೋಷಪಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The children enjoyed watching the marionette show at the fair.

definition: that which is marked, indicated with; a thing that is distingished or characterised by.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆಯ ಲಕ್ಷಿತ ಗುಣ ಬಹಳ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The characteristic feature marked in this statue is very distinctive.

definition: a large expanse of sea; ocean.
example_en: The waves of the ocean dashed against the shore.

definition: a device consisting of bristles, hairs or the like, set in or attached to a hard back, used for painting, cleaning, polishing, grooming, etc.; a brush.
example_en: She cleaned the cloth with a brush.

definition: a confining or being confined under watchful custody.
example_en: The accused was kept under watchful custody.

definition: an invincible man in wars.
example: ಆ ಆಹವದುರ್ಜಯ ರಾಜನನ್ನು ಯಾವ ಶತ್ರುವೂ ಸೋಲಿಸಲಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No enemy could defeat that invincible king in wars.

definition: the tree Spondias pinnata ( = S. mangifera) of anacardiaceae family.
example_en: The fruits of the hindi tree are sour and tasty.

definition: (pl.) five corners; five angles.
example_en: The temple tower is built in a five-cornered shape.

definition: the soft under-plumage of swan.
example_en: They had filled the pillow with the soft under-plumage of a swan.

definition: an instruction; an order; a behest.
example_en: The teacher gave instruction to the disciple.

definition: fame; celebrity; renown.
example_en: The poet's fame crossed the country's borders.

definition: a Jaina temple.
example_en: That town's Jaina temple is very ancient.

definition: to go below the surface of a liquid, esp. water; to sink; to be immersed.
example_en: The boat slowly sank into the water.

definition: one of the backward castes notified by the government.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಕಾಡುಕೊಂಕಿಣಿ ಸಮುದಾಯವನ್ನು ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The government included the Kadu Konkani community among the backward castes.

definition: accidentally; unexpectedly.
example_en: Rain poured down unexpectedly and everyone got wet.

definition: to lead a miserable or wretched life.
example_en: After her husband's death, she led a miserable life.

definition: the efficacy, effect or influence of vedic and other mystical hymns.
example_en: The illness was cured through the guru's mystic mantra power.

definition: the material such as dead cells, and other things expelled by leukocytes from an injured place (as wound) of the body.
example_en: Pus was oozing from the wound.

definition: distressed or afflicted people.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಆರ್ತಜನರಿಗೆ ಆಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಔಷಧಿ ಒದಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The government provided food and medicine to the distressed people.

definition: to pull back; to hold (someone) for punishing.
example_en: The police held back the thief for punishment.

definition: a structure of railings held up by small posts, as on a staircase; a balustrade.
example_en: They built a balustrade beside the staircase.

definition: a man who uses long spears.
example_en: The soldiers who use long spears got ready for war.

definition: the plant Paspalum scrobiculatum ( = P. fumentaceum) of Poaceae family.
example_en: The farmers have grown the kore crop in the field.

definition: the slope of a mountain.
example_en: Water was flowing down the slope of the mountain.

definition: to spend without real gain, advantage; to waste.
example_en: He wasted his wealth in gambling.

definition: any of several types of vultures that feed chiefly or entirely on carrion.
example_en: The carrion vulture was sitting on the dead animal.

definition: anything used to embellish something or someone; an ornament.
example_en: They placed silver ornaments on the deity's idol.

definition: a seasoning of food with oil, spices, asafoetida, etc.
example_en: The cooking needs the seasoning to be just right.

definition: a man who has smeared his body with the sacred ash, made by burning cowdung cakes.
example_en: That ash-smeared devotee was absorbed in meditation on Shiva.

definition: to be fascinated or infatuated.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಆ ಹಾಡಿನ ಸೊಬಗಿಗೆ ಮೆಳ್ಪಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: The girl was fascinated by the beauty of that song.

definition: exact; precise - a) accurately expressed; exact in statement; b) exact in measurement, value, etc.; c) punctilious; scrupulous in being exact, observing rules,time, etc. d) (of a person) tending to precision.
example: ಅವನು ಕರಾರುವಾಕ್ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕಚೇರಿಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He came to the office at the exact, precise time.

definition: a man who helps.
example_en: He was a good helper to everyone.

definition: a particular type of lock in wrestling to overpower the opponent.
example_en: The wrestler applied a lock and threw down his opponent.

definition: to speak slightingly of; to show disrespect for; to belittle; to disparage.
example_en: He treats everyone with respect and never belittles anyone.

definition: the back or hind part; the backside.
example_en: He carried the bag on his backside.

definition: to become excessive; to grow beyond limit or propriety.
example: ಅವನ ಆಸೆ ತಡವಾಗಿ ಮಿತಿ ಮೀರಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His desire grew beyond limit over time.

definition: a staff used to throw at.
example_en: The watchman picked up the throwing staff and threw it.

definition: the external limiting tissue layer of an animal body especially when forming a tough but flexible cover relatively impermeable from without while intact; the skin.
example_en: His skin got burnt from the sun.

definition: an old measure of weight.
example_en: In olden times, grain used to be measured in irpala.

definition: a daughter of one's son or daughter.
example_en: The grandmother lovingly played with her granddaughter.

definition: the moon light.
example_en: Moonlight had spread across the whole sky.

definition: the lip of the colour of a coral.
example_en: The poet described her coral-red lip in his poem.

definition: to become calm, tranquilised.
example_en: When the wind blew, his anger became calm.

definition: any of a large and widely distributed terrestrial or aquatic reptiles of Testudines order, having a toothless beak and a soft body encased in a tough shell into which, in most species, the head, tail, and four legs may be withdrawn; a turtle; a tortoise.
example: ಕೊಳದ ದಂಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೂರುಮ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The tortoise walked slowly on the bank of the pond.

definition: an official journal with a list of government notifications relating to various issues; gazette.
example_en: The new law was published in the gazette.

definition: finished; completed; accomplished.
example_en: This work was completed yesterday itself.

definition: a hollow cylinder or pipe of metal, glass, rubber, etc., usu. long in proportion to its diameter, used for conveying fluids, etc.; a tube.
example_en: They fitted a tube to carry the water.

definition: the royal court-hall.
example_en: The king heard the people's grievances in the royal court-hall.

definition: shining; radiant; lustrous.
example: ಆ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದ್ಯೋತಕ ಕಳೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A radiant glow was clearly visible on that face.

definition: shining brightly; splendid.
example_en: The temple was shining splendidly with brightly shining lamps.

definition: to have name; to be known by one's name.
example_en: That sage became known through his penance.

definition: the first or original type or model from which anything is copied; a prototype.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆ ಪುರಾತನ ಆದಿಪ್ರರೂಪವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This statue was made based on the ancient prototype.

definition: famous; renowned.
example_en: That writer became a famous, renowned person.

definition: (lingu.) absence of accent; condition of being unaccented.
example: ಆ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನಾಘಾತವಿದೆ ಎಂದು ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The scholars said that word has an absence of accent.

definition: a sweet or pleasing scent; fragrance.
example_en: The fragrance of jasmine filled the whole house.

definition: to destroy, demolish completely.
example_en: The flood completely destroyed the old bridge.

definition: a rough cloth.
example_en: She wrapped the goods in a rough cloth.

definition: the household belongings of a person.
example: ಮನೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವಾಗ ಎಲ್ಲ ಗುಡಿಚಾಪೆ ಗಾಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಿದರು.
example_en: While shifting houses, they loaded all the household belongings onto the cart.

definition: a diplomatic representative appointed by one country or government to represent it in another; a diplomat.
example_en: The new diplomat arrived at the country's capital.

definition: the kingdom of gods; the heaven.
example_en: The sage gave a discourse about the heaven, the kingdom of gods.

definition: any of many slender, soft-bodied animals, some segmented, that live by burrowing underground, in water or as parasites, including the annelids, nemerteans, nematodes, platyhelminths, acanthocephalans, and gordian worms; a worm.
example_en: The worm crawled along inside the soil.

definition: a blinking of the eye-lids.
example_en: The light caused a blinking of her eyelids.

definition: prosperity due to flourishing agricultural produce.
example_en: Prosperity came to the village due to a good harvest.

definition: the act of retaliating; return of like for like; reprisal; retaliation.
example_en: It is not right to retaliate against the enemy.

definition: a mineral deposit formed in the kidney that obstructs passage of urine; kidney-stone; renal calculus.
example_en: It was found in the test that he had a kidney stone.

definition: to become violent with intense anger.
example_en: Hearing the insult, he became violent with intense anger.

definition: a particular colour.
example_en: Everyone liked that particular colour of the saree.

definition: a swimming under the surface of water.
example_en: He was swimming underwater in the river.

definition: any intoxicating drink, as toddy, alcholic liquor, etc.
example_en: He drank toddy on the festival day.

definition: a very cruel, malevolent man.
example: ಆ ಕಡುಹಿ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಕರುಣೆ ತೋರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That very cruel man showed mercy to no one in the village.

definition: the sound of biting or chewing crispy food, parched pulse, etc.; the crunching sound.
example_en: A crunching sound came while chewing the fried snack.

definition: the tree Madhuca malabarica ( = Bassia malabarica) of Sapotaceae family.
example_en: The shade of the Madhuca malabarica tree was cool.

definition: the act or an instance of sowing seed (for growing).
example_en: The farmer did the sowing of seed in the field.

definition: to stir (a liquid or pasty item) as to make the sediments suspend throughout; to raise the dirt, impurity.
example_en: The cook stirred the gruel well to raise the sediment.

definition: (said of drinking) with a gulping sound.

definition: a single fold (of a cloth, paper etc.).
example_en: The shopkeeper folded the dhoti into a single fold and put it away.

definition: a man belonging to Tamil Nadu, in south India or a Tamil-speaking man chiefly in Tamil Nadu or Sri Lanka.
example_en: That Tamil man returned to his hometown.

definition: (injury, wound) to happen.
example_en: An injury happened to him while walking in the forest.

definition: the bamboo Oxytenathera monostigma of Poaceae family.
example_en: That species of bamboo grows abundantly in that forest.

definition: the act of attending to a guest.
example_en: The hosts engaged in attending to the guests.

definition: an island made of coral and shaped like a ring with a lake of salt water in the middle; an atoll.

example_en: A beautiful atoll appeared in the middle of the sea.

definition: to get ease and refreshment by ceasing from work or exertion; to rest.
example: ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಅವನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: After finishing the work, he rested for a while.

definition: to cause mental agitation to; to worry; to harass; to vex.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ತುಂಬಾ ಬಾಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That news greatly worried his mind.

definition: a thin, either rectangular or curved piece made of clay, fire clay, which is used for roofing; a tile.
example_en: The roof tile broke during the rainy season.

definition: any short space of time; a moment; an instant.
example_en: He disappeared in a moment.

definition: to make a sound as the one made by dried leaves while being walked on.
example: ಒಣ ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನಡೆದಾಗ ಗಿಱೆಱನ್ ಶಬ್ದ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: When walking on dry leaves, a rustling sound came.

definition: a man with good number of titles to his credit.
example_en: That scholar was renowned as a man of many titles.

definition: a soft lump of earth, clay, etc.; clot.
example_en: Big clots of soil had fallen in the field's mud.

definition: to throw a hook, angle, into water to catch fish.
example: ಅವನು ಕೆರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಣಹಾಕಿ ಮೀನು ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He cast a hook into the pond and waited to catch fish.

definition: the plant Azima tetracantha of Salvadoraceae family.
example_en: There is an esagaḷe plant near the fence.

definition: the harvest season.
example_en: Farmers reap the crop during the harvest season.

example_en: A fingernail scratch was visible on his hand.

definition: for a long duration of time.
example_en: He resided in that town for a long duration of time.

definition: to take a bath; to bathe oneself.
example_en: The travellers went down to bathe in the river.

definition: a pecking or striking with the beak by a bird.
example_en: The hen struck the worm with its beak.

definition: a kind of clay.
example_en: That kind of clay was mixed into the medicine.

definition: (psych.) a person characterised by extroversion; a person concerned primarily with the physical and social environment (opp. to introvert); an extrovert.
example_en: He is an extrovert who mingles easily with people.

definition: a sharp dagger.
example_en: He had tucked a sharp dagger at his waist.

definition: a man who teaches students; a teacher.
example_en: The teacher taught the students a mathematics lesson.

definition: he who breaks, demolishes, destroys; a breaker.
example: ಆ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಕೋಟೆಗೆ ವಿಭಾಡವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಣಮಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That army became the destroyer of the enemy's fort.

definition: a book in which a set of predictions are written.
example_en: The astrologer told the results by looking at the book of predictions.

definition: a swindle or fraud; a scam.
example_en: That merchant cheated people through a swindle.

definition: a wood-cutting machine.
example_en: They cut the wood using a wood-cutting machine at the mill.

example_en: He was muttering in his sleep.

definition: a man who habitually farts.
example: ಹೂಸುಬುರುಕನಾದ ಅವನು ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: Being a habitual farter, he annoyed everyone in the meeting.

definition: a red scorpion.
example_en: A red scorpion was hiding under the stone.

definition: to have bad, negative opinion on (another); to dislike; to feel aversion to.
example_en: Because of his behavior, I came to dislike him.

definition: a false statement; a lie.
example_en: His false statement was exposed in the court.

definition: a series of joined metal links or rings passing through one another, used either for various purposes requiring a flexible tie with high tensile strength, as for hauling, supporting or confining; a chain.
example_en: They tied the dog with a chain.

definition: a singing inconsistently with the base pitch or using discordant notes.
example: ಅವನ ಹಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಗಾನ ಇತ್ತು, ರಾಗ ತಪ್ಪಿ ಹೋಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: There was dissonance in his singing; the raga had gone off-key.

definition: a chasing of animals in hunting.
example_en: In the hunting chase, the dogs pursued the deer.

definition: a starting or commencing; a beginning.
example_en: The beginning of the story was very interesting.

definition: a piece of meat (flesh).
example_en: A piece of meat was needed for the cooking.

definition: a seat (as a stool, chair, etc.) that has four legs.
example_en: They had placed a four-legged stool in the corner of the room.

definition: the end of anything; finish.
example: ಕೆಲಸದ ಕಲಾಸ್ ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋದರು.
example_en: After the finish of the work, everyone went home.

definition: the state of being unified in another; a becoming one; a union of actions or purposes.
example_en: Everyone's union of purpose made our work a success.

definition: presented; gifted.
example_en: The guest liked the gift that was presented.

definition: a lash attached to a stick for urging on animals or punishing etc.; a whip.

example_en: He held a whip in his hand and threatened the horse.

definition: a hook that joins the spindle to the wheel in a spinning machine.
example_en: The hook joining the spindle to the spinning wheel broke.

definition: the space, amount or degree to which a thing extends; extent.
example: ಆ ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಪರ್ಬುಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He asked how great the extent of that field was.

definition: the act or an instance of approaching; a going near.
example_en: A new approach is needed to solve the problem.

example_en: The tourists enjoyed themselves in that cool, pleasant forest.

definition: the quality or state of being completely filled (with); fullness.

example_en: The fullness of the lake's water brought joy to everyone.

definition: to become entangled and intertwined or complicated.
example_en: The knot in the thread became entangled and was hard to untie.

definition: an opportunity that is favourable for achieving something.
example_en: Today is a favourable time to finish the work.

example_en: The gathering of all the materials took place in one room.

example_en: This machine is a very latest invention.

example_en: The crop that grew in the tree's shade became stunted for lack of sunlight.

definition: a plane figure with four angles and four sides; a quadrangle.
example_en: That ground was in the shape of a quadrangle.

definition: a cover for protecting the body, used esp. by soldiers; an armour; a defensive coat.
example: ಸೈನಿಕ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಅವುತೆಯನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The soldier wore the armour before going to war.

definition: to draw back the lips so as to show the teeth (as a snarling dog or a person in wrath); to grin (angrily).

definition: pure, unadulterated milk.

definition: a man not morally or religiously spoiled; a stainless, spotless man.
example_en: That saint led a stainless, spotless life.

definition: an armed conflict between two countries, rival factions, etc.; a war.

example_en: The multitude gathered for the fair had filled the entire ground.

definition: the cardinal number seventy; 70.
example: ಆ ಮುದುಕನಿಗೆ ಈಗ ಸಪ್ತತಿ ವರ್ಷ ವಯಸ್ಸು.
example_en: That old man is now seventy years of age.

definition: the quality of having little weight or no weight.
example: ಆ ಹಗುರ ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ನೊಚ್ಚಿತು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯವನ್ನುಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The lightness of that object caused him wonder.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.
example_en: The villagers had to pay the baluku-neeru tax.

definition: a formal permission to do something given by an authority; licence.
example_en: He obtained a driving licence.

definition: a man who is with, is associated with or accompanies (gen. always) (another); a companion.
example_en: He travelled as my companion.

definition: (fit) to be meditated, chanted (religiously).
example_en: The guru said that this mantra is fit to be chanted.

definition: tending to advice; giving or containing advice.
example_en: The teacher's words used to be advisory in nature.

definition: with speed; swiftly; quickly.
example_en: The horse ran off swiftly.

definition: to give (something) for temporary use or consumption on condition that the same or its equivalent, and with interest, be returned; to lend.
example: ಅವನು ನನಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹಣ ಎರಂಗುಡು ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He asked me to lend him a little money.

definition: any of several swift, perissodactylous mammals (family Equidae) of the same genus (Equus) as the horse and ass, having dark stripes on a white or tawny body; a zebra.
example: ಪೇಸರು ಬಿಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಪ್ಪು ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: The zebra has white and black stripes.

definition: a deep trench, dug around a fortified place, and filled with water.
example_en: A water-filled trench was dug for the protection of the fort.

definition: (collectively) dried sticks, twigs of plants.
example_en: She has dried enough twigs needed for cooking.

definition: a brief, light sleep; doze; nap.
example_en: The baby was taking a brief, light nap in the cradle.

definition: the kitchen waste water.
example_en: The kitchen waste water should be let into the drain.

definition: to go back to original or previous place; to retreat.
example_en: The enemy army, defeated, retreated back.

definition: a man who drives an evil spirit out or away by ritual pryers, incantations, etc.; an exorcist.
example_en: The exorcist chanted mantras and drove away the evil spirit.

definition: to begin; to start; to commence.
example_en: The teacher began the lesson from the new chapter.

definition: want of order, arrangement, system, etc.; disorderliness.
example_en: There was excessive disorderliness in that office.

definition: to taste or lick a small quantity of pickles or other condiments for adding taste or flavour to the principal food.
example: ಅನ್ನದ ರುಚಿಗಾಗಿ ಅವನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಉಪ್ಪಿನಕಾಯಿಯನ್ನು ನೆಂಜಿದನು.
example_en: He tasted a little pickle to add flavour to the rice.

definition: to break, infringe or transgress (a law, rule, agreement, promise, instructions, etc.); to violate.
example_en: He violated the rule.

definition: shaped like a ball; spherical.
example_en: That ball was spherical in shape.

definition: got up; rised.
example_en: The sun rose up from beyond the hill.

definition: that much quantity (of food) served at one time.
example_en: A serving of rice was given to each person at that time.

definition: the royal court-hall.
example_en: The king heard the people's grievances in the royal court-hall.
